vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an addBots() function that is only callable by the owner (onlyOwner modifier). This function allows the owner to add any address to a botlist mapping. When antibot is enabled (default true), the _transfer() function checks if either sender or recipient is in botlist and reverts if true. This gives the owner arbitrary power to block any address from transacting, which is a privilege abuse vulnerability.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call addBots() with the victim's address to add them to the botlist. This will demonstrate that the owner can arbitrarily block any address.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the owner address of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call addBots() with an array containing the victim address and status=true. 4. Verify that botlist[victim] is now true.
